concept.title: Library and lending services
concept.shortdesc: Borrowing books and other items from a library or lending library, with some related access to resources.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: book club or reading group: see (group discussion rather than borrowing)
